# TelemarkTalk

> > The longest-running online community for telemark and free-heel skiing enthusiasts, featuring forums, trip reports, gear discussions, and the TELEWIKI knowledge base.

TelemarkTalk has been the premier destination for telemark and backcountry skiing discussion since 1998. The community covers everything from technique and gear (including equipment like Rainey Designs Superloop, Sbound 98s, and Sbound 112s) to trip planning and regional skiing conditions.
